title: Glovida-RX
line: A healthcare platform for managing medical prescriptions.
problem: Glovida-RX is a digital healthcare platform that streamlines prescription management between doctors, pharmacists and patients. Product prices and medication details were not always updating correctly between the doctor and pharmacist roles.
did: As a Full-stack Developer, I resolved issues with dynamic state updates in key UI components, ensuring that product prices and medication details updated accurately in real time. I also improved the backend state handling between the pharmacist and doctor roles so the data reflected correctly across the platform.
outcome: Doctors and pharmacists now see accurate information straight away, allowing for faster and more reliable decisions.

story.title: The Problem
story.body: Glovida-RX is a digital healthcare platform that streamlines prescription management between doctors, pharmacists and patients. Product prices and medication details were not always updating correctly between the different roles, which meant someone could end up looking at outdated information.

story.title: What I Did
story.body: As a Full-stack Developer, I resolved the issues with dynamic state updates in key UI components, so a change made by one role now shows up correctly for everyone else. I also improved the backend state handling between the pharmacist and doctor roles. For this project, I worked with Next.js, React, TypeScript and GraphQL, and used TablePlus to inspect the data.

story.title: The Result
story.body: Doctors and pharmacists now see accurate information in real time, allowing them to make faster and more reliable decisions.
